triggerReason: The constrained agent runtime could schedule deterministic policies, but it lacked a safe boundary for fallible external model proposals and explicit human authorization.
action: Added a pluggable model-provider interface, deterministic mock provider, structured proposal validation, prompt and policy versioning, token/cost/timeout budgets, fallback behavior, risk-tiered approval, and an Observer approval queue.
outcome: Model output is now treated as untrusted advice. Only validated and policy-approved commands enter the deterministic run, while medium and high risk proposals require an auditable human decision.
evidence: Deterministic mock proposals are byte-equivalent for the same seed and context
Malformed, timeout, token/cost budget, capability, and critical-risk paths cannot bypass validation
Medium-risk proposals require explicit approval before entering the next simulation tick
Approved model commands produce observation, proposal, command, execution, and evaluation records
Observer browser coverage verifies pending, approved, and executed approval states
ARIA exposes model provenance, usage, latency, approval status, and fallback reason
